{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 0.50

|gr1= Containers

|descr= Returns current percentage of mass from items stored in a backpack relative to the maximum capacity of the backpack.<br>
It is equivalent to this formula:
<sqf>_loadBackpack = massOfAllItemsInBackpack / getContainerMaxLoad backpack player;</sqf>

|s1= [[loadBackpack]] unit

|p1= unit: [[Object]]

|r1= [[Number]]

|x1= <sqf>private _myVariable = loadBackpack myUnit;</sqf>
